NAME: PCMCIA
NOTE: Legacy Interface for Laptops. Extensions at the end are permissible for connectors.

NAME: ExpressCard/34
NOTE: Legacy Interface for Laptops, Successor to PCIMCIA, 70mm depth is designed to sit flush with a laptop case. Extensions are permissible.

NAME: ExpressCard/54
NOTE: Wider variant in an L-Lshaped case. Same Connector as ExpressCard/34.

NAME: GamePak
NOTE: ROM Cartridge for the GameBoy. Sits flush with GameBoy & GameBoy Colour.

NAME: GamePak Advanced
NOTE: Revised Version of the Cartridge, sits flush with all GameBoy Advance Models.

NAME: ExpressCard 2.0
NOTE: Identical to ExpressCard, but with PCIe 2.0 & USB 3.0 support

NAME: XQD
NOTE: Successor to Compact Flash for professional cameras.

NAME: CompactFlash
NOTE: A common storage media that provides IDE support.

NAME: MicroDrive
NOTE: A miniature HDD in a CompactFlash Type 2 Form Factor.

NAME: CFast
NOTE: An incompatible cartridge that does use SATA and merely has the same external dimensions as the oridingal CF card.

NAME: ID-1 Chipcard
NOTE: Full-Size Chipcard as used for ATMs.

NAME: MiniPCIe
NOTE: Expansion Slot for Laptop WWAN, WiFi and SSDs.

NAME: SFP
NOTE: Used to attach Ethernet Fiber Modules.
